programme.title: Freaky Ali
programme.desc: A sports comedy film that tells the story of a poor man who discovers his natural talent for golf and decides to pursue a career in the sport. With the help of his friend and coach, he enters a tournament to compete against professional golfers and prove himself. The movie highlights themes of determination, hard work, and overcoming social barriers in an entertaining and uplifting plot.

programme.title: Zed Plus
programme.desc: A political satire set in a small town in Rajasthan, where the local government is on the verge of collapsing due to factors such as corruption and mismanagement.

programme.title: One Day: Justice Delivered
programme.desc: A judge bound by law has to pass unfair judgments on some criminal cases due to lack of evidence. After retirement, he becomes a vigilante and decides to punish the crooks who walk free.

programme.title: Barsaat
programme.desc: The actions of Sabarwal, a trickster in the guise of a high-profile businessman, lead to the death and imprisonment of innocent people. The affected victims decide to take revenge on the trickster.

programme.title: Bollywood Diaries
programme.desc: Rohit, Vishnu, and Imli are aspiring actors who come from different backgrounds and dream to make it big in Bollywood. However, each of them must diligently brave both internal and professional struggles to even survive in the coveted industry.
